summary: "We want League to stand the test of time."
body: Riot has announced a League of Legends overhaul that promises to touch every aspect of the game. "We want League to stand the test of time and be a game that's here for many years to come," said League Studio head Andrei "Meddler" van Roon in a teaser trailer . "And there are a lot of things that need to be true to make that happen." The headlining changes coming with the update, called New Dawn, are a "modernized" client, a graphical revamp for the 5v5 map Summoner's Rift (the last time this happened was in 2014 ), and "new ways to play" each champion. While details are scarce in the teaser, some brief footage is shown where you can see what he's talking about: a Blitzcrank player selects what looks like a character-specific mastery tree labeled "God Hand," and it cuts to him beating up an enemy in melee. Other champions are shown using abilities in ways they currently can't—Vayne, for instance, dashes through a wall. An updated art style is also shown off, including new character models for all sorts of champions as well as bosses like Baron Nashor and the Elder Dragon. body: Weird Weekend Weird Weekend is our regular Saturday column where we celebrate PC gaming oddities: peculiar games, strange bits of trivia, forgotten history. Pop back every weekend to find out what Jeremy, Josh, Rick and Ted have become obsessed with this time, whether it's the canon height of Thief's Garrett or that time someone in the Vatican pirated Football Manager . What's the fastest you've ever fallen in love with a game? I think I have a new record: about 0.3 seconds into CultGame , when launching it from Steam spawned not a regular game window, but a command prompt instance. Perfection. Chef's kiss. No notes. Like the Bay 12 games (Dwarf Fortress and especially Liberal Crime Squad ) it clearly takes inspiration from, CultGame is gloriously text-based.
